mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course( course_name, course_code, teacher_id, dept_id, status, semester, is_public, cover_url, description, version )VALUES( #{courseName}, #{courseCode}, #{teacherId}, #{deptId}, #{status}, #{semester}, #{isPublic}, #{coverUrl}, #{description}, #{version} )
mapper.select: SELECT course_id, course_name, course_code, teacher_id, dept_id, status, semester, is_public, cover_url, description, version, created_at, updated_at FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT course_id, course_name, course_code, dept_id, semester, is_public, cover_url, description FROM course WHERE course_id = #{sourceCourseId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
